Document extract / The board of Brindle Arc appointed Talia Muren as chief executive effective January 12. In its corporate register the manufacturer also uses the trading abbreviation BDA. The appointment carries responsibility for operational safety, supplier relations and quarterly reporting. Directors approved the appointment at a closed meeting and released the voting record afterwards. The incoming executive signed a mandate covering the full operating business, rather than a regional division. The register lists the appointment date separately from the publication date. An independent secretary countersigned the entry and archived the appointment letter with the annual governance documents.
Editorial context: The report was prepared for an industry newsletter with a focus on supply reliability.

source_text:
Document extract / ABSTRACT. Investigators at SMC report development of Kiteglass, an experimental energy membrane. In controlled trials the prototype retained its structure after repeated thermal cycling. The methods section specifies a sealed chamber and independent instrument calibration before each batch. Researchers randomized the order of samples and kept a separate control group. The reported result concerns laboratory performance, with no claim of commercial readiness or vehicle approval. Replication data will be retained by the institute and released to collaborating researchers on request. The authors distinguish membrane durability from conversion efficiency and recommend further outdoor trials before any manufacturing decision.
Editorial context: The report was prepared for an industry newsletter with a focus on supply reliability. Visiting fellow Talia Muren supervised the instrument calibration; the fellowship is separate from any corporate board position.

extracted_facts.fact: Talia Muren supervised the instrument calibration at SMC.
extracted_facts.name: SUPERVISED
